cases.title: 高亮／粗体／代码混排
cases.source: A daemon on your Mac drives the phone in three forms: an MCP server for your agent; an HTTP API for scripts (/agent/*); and a web page and native iOS app for people.
cases.requirement: **P0**：对应中文片段保留粗体、高亮，代码原样保护
cases.accept: 不是整段统一粗体或高亮；语序变化后仍对应正确内容，代码字符与外观保留

cases.title: 语义强调
cases.source: Please save your changes before closing the window. The primary account is active, the temporary account expires tomorrow, and the backup account stays available. Read the important notice and ignore the outdated instruction.
cases.requirement: 粗体 **P0**；斜体、下划线、删除线 **P1**
cases.accept: 逐种格式记录结果；斜体未通过不改变粗体的验收判定

cases.title: 背景高亮
cases.source: The report says payment is due next Friday, while the shipping address must be confirmed today. Keep both reminders visible.
cases.requirement: 高亮 **P0**，包括原站成功样本，不把本地失败隐藏掉
cases.accept: 对应提醒内容带高亮，普通文字不被扩大标记；背景与用户文字颜色分别处理

cases.title: 纯样式跨度
cases.source: The failed payment needs attention, the approved payment needs no action, and the pending payment will be checked tomorrow.
cases.requirement: 其他自定义局部样式 **P1**；已明确的粗体、高亮 **P0** 规则仍适用；原文字颜色按用户设置覆盖
cases.accept: 按具体效果分别验收，不把原网页红字覆盖用户译文颜色作为成功条件

cases.title: 嵌套格式
cases.source: You must confirm the correct delivery date before paying. The next three business days are reserved for review.
cases.requirement: 复杂嵌套 **P1**
cases.accept: 内容完整，已恢复的格式边界正确；不得把内层样式错误扩大到整句

cases.title: 行内代码
cases.source: Send a request to /agent/* and set IPHONE_USE_NO_CLIENT_SETUP=1 before starting. The result field retry_safe must remain unchanged in your script.
cases.accept: 三段代码字符逐项不变，代码仍可辨识；周围正文正常翻译

cases.title: 显式不翻译内容
cases.source: The command npm install example-package prepares the project. Keep the variable CUSTOM_SESSION_ID unchanged, then read the translated instructions carefully.
cases.requirement: 代码保护 **P0**；通用“不翻译”标记的新增支持暂不承诺本期
cases.accept: 分别核对代码原样、变量文字和标记规则，不以变量碰巧未变证明规则生效

cases.title: 键位／输出／变量／上下标
cases.source: Press Ctrl + C to copy the result. The output READY_OK confirms success. Calculate x2 and check H2O in the reference.
cases.requirement: 键位、输出片段、上下标 **P0**；变量格式暂不承诺本期新增
cases.accept: 键名和输出字符不改，上下标仍对应原位置；变量格式独立记录

cases.title: 链接及链接内粗体
cases.source: Read the complete installation guide before you continue. Visit the account security page if your access has expired.
cases.requirement: 译文链接新增适配暂不承诺本期；原链接保持可用，粗体按其适用规则记录
cases.accept: 不能把原链接可点击当作译文链接已支持；本期不得破坏原链接目标和功能

cases.title: 标题字体与层级
cases.source:
Connect your agent to the right device

Check the connection before sending a request

The title and subtitle intentionally use different font families and sizes.
cases.requirement: 标题结构 **P0**；字体按共同策略尽量跟随，不宣称竞品字体全面通过
cases.accept: 标题层级与位置不乱；分别检查标题、正文及代码的实际字体和缺字回退

cases.title: 显式换行
cases.source:
The first delivery arrives on Monday.
The second delivery arrives on Tuesday.

The final delivery must not arrive before Friday.
cases.requirement: 换行 **P0**，粗体按对应 **P0** 规则单独验收
cases.accept: 按可见行边界形成清楚的双语对应，不合并丢行或重复插入

cases.title: 预格式换行／缩进
cases.source: Prepare the installation files. - Open the browser settings. - Confirm the correct extension folder. Restart the browser after installation.
cases.requirement: 已支持的换行、空行及步骤基本结构 **P0**；完整缩进暂不承诺本期新增
cases.accept: 内容顺序、换行及空行保留；前导空格另记结果，不以整组通过遮盖损失

cases.title: 普通源码换行
cases.source: This sentence is split across several lines in the HTML source, but it should remain one normal paragraph in the browser.
cases.accept: 按浏览器可见段落处理，不能把源码排版换行误当真实分段

cases.title: 嵌套列表
cases.source:
1. Download the correct package for your operating system.
  2. Review these requirements:
    • Keep the installation directory available.
    • Do not delete your saved browser settings.
  3. Restart the browser and verify the result.
cases.requirement: 列表结构、局部粗体均 **P0**，分别验收
cases.accept: 编号与层级不乱，译文不跨列表项；粗体保留不能用列表结构继承代替

cases.title: 表格／表头／标题
cases.source:
Delivery schedule for three customer groups
Customer groupDelivery dateStatus
Business customersNovember 12Confirmation required
Personal customersNovember 15Ready for delivery
cases.requirement: 表格结构 **P0**；单元格内格式按对应 P0／P1 规则验收，缺证部分**需要我们调研／复测**
cases.accept: 表格标题与单元格对应不乱，不能把表格转成纯文本；局部格式单独核对

cases.title: 引用与代码块
cases.source:
Please keep the original receipt until the refund has been confirmed.
export API_MODE="safe"
curl https://example.invalid/status
# Do not translate the executable command above.
cases.accept: 引用正文完整；代码块字符、换行保持原样，不把可执行命令当正文翻译

cases.title: 透明章节定位符
cases.source:
Already done by the installer#

The installer prepares the required files and checks the current browser version.
cases.accept: 标题译文无多余井号，原链接仍能定位；不能据此全局删除所有透明元素

cases.title: 隐藏与不翻译范围
cases.source:
Only the visible delivery instructions should appear in the translated paragraph.Hidden account reset instruction.Invisible payment instruction.Transparent diagnostic message.

This entire sentence must remain in English.

This second sentence must also remain in English.
cases.requirement: 已验证的隐藏辅助内容过滤行为 **P0**；其他隐藏与通用不翻译规则暂不承诺本期新增
cases.accept: 对各隐藏原因分别记录；正文完整，不能以过滤为由删除真实可见内容

cases.title: 装饰和图标
cases.source: The installation guide is ready. The confirmation symbol should stay next to this sentence.
cases.requirement: **P0**：正文完整、原图标保留；复杂装饰重建另行调研
cases.accept: 原装饰／图标仍可见，译文不引入无关辅助文字或重复图标；不要求译文另复制一个图标

cases.title: 原生公式
cases.source: The calculation uses x2+y2=z2 to describe the relationship. Keep the formula unchanged and translate this explanation.
cases.requirement: **P0**，限本次原生公式样例，不自动覆盖所有公式库
cases.accept: 公式内容、结构、位置正确，说明正常翻译，内部保护标记不出现在译文

cases.title: 连续符号与字符画
cases.source: ---[INSTALLATION GUIDE]----- Chapter One ............ 12 ##### Important notice ##### +-------------------------+ The process is ready to start.
cases.requirement: 已支持的符号基本结构 **P0**；完整连续符号保护及严格空白对齐暂不承诺本期新增
cases.accept: 分项检查符号组是否仍在及正文是否完整；不能写成全部字符画逐字符通过

cases.title: 按钮／勾选／折叠
cases.source:
Confirm that you have read the installation instructions before continuing.

点击次数：0

Read the additional installation requirements

The browser must remain open while the extension folder is being selected.
cases.accept: 原按钮继续计数；勾选、展开状态保留；不复制控件，不重置用户操作

cases.title: 动态新增内容
cases.source: The current installation guide is visible before the dynamic content is added.
cases.requirement: 动态处理 **P0**；格式采用与静态内容相同的 P0／P1 规则
cases.accept: 每个当前有效段落只出现一份译文；不让旧响应覆盖新正文，动态强调与代码分别验收

cases.title: 原站首段逐字复制
cases.source: A daemon on your Mac drives the phone and offers the same control in three forms: an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients; an HTTP API for agents and scripts (/agent/*); and a web page and native iOS app for people.
cases.requirement: **P0 对照案例**，不是新增站点专属功能
cases.accept: 在原站和受控页分别验收同套规则，不能用单站成功代替通用能力验证

cases.title: 移除测试属性
cases.source: Please save your changes before closing the window. The temporary account expires tomorrow. The shipping address must be confirmed today, and the delivery date is next Friday.
cases.requirement: **控制变量案例**：粗体、高亮按 P0，斜体按 P1
cases.accept: 移除测试属性不能改变应达到的规则；按各格式结果记录，不另算一项功能

cases.title: 移除段落样式类
cases.source: A daemon on your Mac drives the phone and offers the same control in three forms: an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients; an HTTP API for agents and scripts (/agent/*); and a web page and native iOS app for people.
cases.requirement: **P0 控制变量案例**
cases.accept: 粗体、高亮和代码目标不依赖该段落样式类；不能据此声称已确认竞品内部原因

cases.title: 短句强调
cases.source: The installation files are ready. Keep the original folder until the process is complete.
cases.requirement: **P0 控制变量案例**
cases.accept: 短句同样保留正确粗体、高亮；不能以缩短句子代替解决格式映射
